principles: Gate remediation must recommend commands that actually exist in the current checkout.
Story worktree evidence must be tied to current worktree code, not a bare global CLI that may resolve to main or another checkout.
Compatibility is first-class: legacy koala-codex and koala.js wrappers remain accepted while Lattice names are primary when present.
The fix stays narrow and testable, with JSON stdout and non-Swift validation preserved.
drivers: Global lattice can legitimately point at main dist, so acceptance must classify it instead of mutating it.
Review and DONE gates consume structured evidence; hints and rendered command labels must agree with resolver details.

options.name: wrapper-aware resolver plus worktree-local guidance
pros: Fixes both real pitfalls without changing global installation semantics.
Keeps legacy compatibility and Lattice migration semantics explicit.
Can be covered by focused smokes and existing gate paths.
cons: Requires touching both core evidence summary and preflight rendering paths.
May expose old docs/tests that assumed one canonical wrapper name.

options.name: force global lattice to current story worktree
pros: Would make bare lattice less surprising inside a worktree.
cons: Breaks host-neutral/global CLI expectations and can corrupt parallel story workflows.
Does not fix missing lattice-codex wrapper hints in legacy repos.

options.name: docs-only warning
cons: Does not repair mechanical gate output; developers would still see nonexistent commands in REVIEW/DONE.

rationale: This is the only option that fixes the gate-consumed behavior and the user-facing remediation text while preserving parallel worktree and global CLI semantics.

preMortem.scenario: Preflight still displays LOCAL_CODEX_VERIFY_COMMAND even though evidence summary resolved a legacy command.
preMortem.trigger: Only codex-adapter-checks is changed, but review-preflight renderer keeps its hardcoded command label.
preMortem.consequence: User still receives a nonexistent command in REVIEW/DONE despite core resolver improvements.
preMortem.mitigation: Add a regression that exercises rendered preflight output and asserts legacy wrapper command appears.

preMortem.scenario: Stale global lattice is treated as failure everywhere.
preMortem.trigger: Doctor/runtime checks hard-fail when global realpath differs from worktree root.
preMortem.consequence: External projects and main checkout workflows get noisy false failures.
preMortem.mitigation: Classify stale global as advisory/heartbeat fallback for self-development worktrees, not a universal hard fail.

preMortem.scenario: Tests reintroduce Swift/Mac Native validation evidence.
preMortem.trigger: Validation command selection follows old koala validate fallback paths without scrutiny.
preMortem.consequence: Story appears done using legacy product runtime evidence the user explicitly deprecated.
preMortem.mitigation: Use focused Node/Lattice CLI smokes and record no Swift/Mac Native commands as delivery evidence.
